name: hydroxymethylbilane synthase

function.text: HMBS encodes porphobilinogen deaminase. Annotated molecular activities include hydroxymethylbilane synthase activity. It participates in heme biosynthetic process and heme B biosynthetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to acute intermittent porphyria (autosomal dominant) (semidominant); acute intermittent porphyria (autosomal dominant) (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Semidominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: HMBS encodes porphobilinogen deaminase. The covalently linked cofactor acts as a primer, around which the tetrapyrrole product is assembled.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with acute intermittent porphyria (autosomal dominant) (semidominant); acute intermittent porphyria (autosomal dominant) (autosomal dominant).
